findings.pdf_says: Figure D.3 is a drawn box diagram: a heavy-bordered Compilation Group holding three compilation units; the middle one holds source unit P-1 containing a dashed source element, source unit P-1-1 (with a dashed element) and source unit P-1-2 (with a dashed element and nested units P-1-2-1 and P-1-2-2, each with a dashed element). Arrows lead from the outer compilation units 'To other run unit', and a bracket with an arrow maps the middle compilation unit to a Runtime Module in a heavy-bordered Run Unit below, whose outer modules receive arrows 'From other comp. group'. A legend maps border styles to Compilation Group, Compilation Unit, Source Unit, Source Element, Run Unit, Runtime Module and Runtime Element.
